question: If the interest earned during the 2nd year on a certain sum is ₹1,760, and the rate of interest is 10% per annum compounded annually, then the sum is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective interest rate for the 2nd year alone = R% + (R% of R%) = 10% + 1% = 11%.

11% of the Principal = ₹1,760

1% of the Principal = 1760 ÷ 11 = ₹160

100% of the Principal = 160 × 100 = ₹16,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹16,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Rate of interest (R) = 10% per annum

Interest earned during the 2nd year = ₹1,760

**Formula Used:**

Amount after n years = P × (1 + R/100)ⁿ

Interest for the n-th year = Amount after (n−1) years × (R/100)
